Outfit Finder
See a look online? Right-click it.

Right-click any photo on any site and choose "Find with AI". Your results open right beside the page.

Chrome Web Store listing coming soon
Desktop Chrome, Edge and Brave
1
Add to Chrome

One click from the Chrome Web Store.

2
Right-click a photo

Choose "Find with AI" from the menu.

3
Shop or sew

Results open in a side panel next to the page.

What the extension can access
Right-click menu	Adds "Find with AI" when you right-click an image.
Side panel	Shows your results next to the page you're on.
The image you clicked	Only that one image, only when you choose "Find with AI". If the site blocks direct downloads, the extension copies the image from the page instead.
Storage	Remembers your visitor ID and sign-in on this browser.
Sign-in	Opens the Outfit Finder sign-in page in a pop-up window.

It never reads pages you don't right-click, and it doesn't track your browsing.

Privacy Policy
Privacy
Terms
Cookies
Report content
Version 1.0, effective 1 December 2026. Draft text: final wording needs legal review.
What we collect

The photos you upload, the clothing results we find, your username, your email address if you choose to give one, and body measurements if you choose to add them. If you accept our cookie, we also keep a random visitor ID so your looks are remembered on this device.

How photos are handled

Each photo is first checked for unsafe content by [CONTENT SAFETY PROVIDER]. It is then sent to our AI provider ([AI PROVIDER]) to find the clothing and where to buy it. Faces are blurred, and only the blurred copy is saved. The original upload is deleted as soon as the search finishes. Photos that fail the safety check are never stored; we keep only a fingerprint (hash) and the reason, to stop repeat uploads.

How long we keep it

Photos and results are deleted after 90 days. You can delete any search, or everything, at any time from Account & privacy.

Who processes your data

[HOSTING PROVIDER] hosts the service. [AI PROVIDER] analyses photos. [CONTENT SAFETY PROVIDER] checks photos for unsafe content. We do not sell your data and we do not show ads.

Your rights

You can download your data, correct it, or delete your account and everything in it from Account & privacy. You can also contact us at [PRIVACY EMAIL]. If you are in the EU or UK you may com

Terms of Service
Privacy
Terms

Report content
Version 1.0, effective 1 December 2026. Draft text: final wording needs legal review.
Who can use it

You must be 16 or older to use Outfit Finder.

Photos you upload

Only upload photos you have the right to use. No photos of children, and no explicit or illegal content. Repeated attempts to upload unsafe content will block uploads from your device.

Results

Matches, prices and stock come from other websites and can be wrong or out of date. Check with the store before you buy. We are not the seller and are not responsible for third-party stores.

Patterns

Patterns are drafted in the style of a garment for personal use. They are not copies of the original design. Logos and branded prints are never included.

Misuse

We can suspend accounts that break these terms. Report a problem or ask for content to be removed using the takedown form, or email [ABUSE EMAIL].

The cookies we use

One cookie (gf_visitor) remembers your looks on this device, and only after you accept it. When you sign in, one more cookie keeps you signed in. A tiny setting in your browser remembers light or dark mode. That is all.

What we do not use

No advertising cookies and no third-party tracking.

Your choice

If you decline, the site still works but your looks are not remembered between visits. You can change your mind at any time from the footer link "Cookie settings".
